decisions.reason: As a flagship offering on the home page that builds directly on the firm's core messaging and cloud expertise, it fits strongly with the firm's absorptive capacity and strategic direction.
Document capture and recognition is still closely related to the firm's electronic document workflow capabilities, and the firm's own R&D should help it refine and commercialize the service.

Email and fax conversion is adjacent to the firm's established multichannel communications business, so despite its lower prominence the firm is likely to retain it for regulated and legacy-heavy customers.

This optimization feature is very close to the existing fax business and thus learnable for the firm, though its narrower scope and limited prominence make it somewhat more exposed to being folded into other offers.
Email sandbox threat protection complements the firm's secure messaging and compliance positioning, and the firm's R&D base increases its ability to improve the product from early market feedback.

Multi-engine email virus scanning is a close extension of the firm's security capabilities, so the product is likely to stay, although its lower visibility suggests a slightly higher chance of later rationalization than the most prominent offers.
